part.text:
Fixed the issue in tsdb/head_append.go:1285: when the head chunk has reached the size limit, the out-of-order/duplicate check (`c.maxTime >= t`) now runs *before* cutting a new chunk and returns `chunkCreated=false`, so the duplicate sample is discarded without creating an overlapping empty chunk.

Verification: `go test ./tsdb/ -run "TestAppend|TestMemSeries|TestHead"` passes in the testbed container.
